connector.name: Measure Space MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for weather, climate, air quality, agriculture, pollen and geocoding from measurespace.io
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package measure-space-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the measurespace account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
